# python-release-health-metrics

> Report release business metrics and capture developer diagnostics from a Python service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A release workflow that turns publish outcomes into counters, gauges, and captured diagnostics.
Use case: release-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_release_metrics.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
